title: Enterprise Connectivity: correctable transfer volume
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this correctable transfer volume rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: included volume
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, read monthly included outbound transfer from the source interval tier.

## Scope clause 17
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, determine this one charge's corrected target from all of those monthly exports less one full monthly outbound-transfer inclusion, with a zero floor, instead of assigning a separate remaining included volume to each contributing export.

## Basis: chargeable
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, floor the difference between measured quantity and that included volume at zero before applying any rate.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs corrected monthly transfer assessment here?** Floor the difference between measured quantity and that included volume at zero before applying any rate.

## Hypothetical volume boundary
For hypothetical measured volume of 18 GB and an included volume of 20 GB, the chargeable excess is zero. For 23 GB against that same hypothetical inclusion, the excess is 3 GB.
